summaries.name: Egg Salad
summaries.summary: Classic egg salad recipe: 4-6 hard-boiled eggs chopped, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard (optional), 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill pickles (optional), salt and pepper to taste, garnished with fresh chives or parsley (optional). Combine ingredients, season, refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving on bread, crackers, or alone. Can be customized with chopped onions, capers, fresh herbs, grated cheese, or lemon juice. Can be frozen in airtight containers for up to 3 months.
